header: Dated entries down a line, in order
lead: Two to twenty milestones, each with a date, a heading and a short text. It is a real ordered list, so the order stays clear even without styles.

entries.title: The date sits above the heading
entries.text: The value field holds the year or date. The unit field next to it takes a month or a quarter.

entries.title: The connecting line is a border
entries.text: Each entry draws its own part of the line, so the line never runs past the last entry.

entries.title: The last entry ends the line
entries.text: Its border is transparent, and the dot still marks where the sequence stops.
